text:
lucas: Hey team — need quick guidance. I separated from my spouse last month (living apart) and we finalized separation paperwork in Canada on 2026-03-10. I'm planning to remove them from my benefits. What event type do I pick, and can coverage end retroactive to the separation date? Also worried about COBRA options and any payroll reimbursements.
noah-benefits: Sorry to hear that, Lucas. Short answers: pick 'Remove dependent — qualifying life event (loss of coverage/termination of relationship)'. You have 30 days from the date of the qualifying event (separation/finalization) to request removal. Coverage end date can be set to the separation date if you submit within 30 days.
lucas: Thanks. Our separation paperwork is in French (Quebec court). Do you require an apostille or certified translation?
noah-benefits: Certified translation is fine; apostille not required. For foreign court docs we ask for either the court decree + certified translation or an embassy/consulate confirmation. Upload both if possible. We also accept a notarized English affidavit as a temporary doc.
peopleops-sarah: Additional note: if spouse is losing access to employer coverage, they may be eligible for COBRA/continuation. If spouse lives outside the US we still trigger COBRA if they were covered under Redwood plans. Noah will send specifics.
noah-benefits: COBRA: If your spouse was covered under our plan immediately before the event, they are entitled to COBRA notification. Payroll will generate notification to your (former) spouse's last known email on file. If they are overseas, they still have the same election window (60 days to elect). Coverage termination date for payroll reconciliation will be the effective end date you choose when reporting.
payroll-bot: FYI: Payroll proration rules: if coverage ends retroactive to 2026-03-10 but payroll already ran for March, we adjust retro premiums in the next two pay cycles. You may see a one-time refund or smaller deduction depending on timing. You can request a manual split adjustment to spread impact — email payroll@redwood.example.
lucas: If I remove them now and they elect COBRA, does Redwood provide paperwork with instructions for enrolling from outside the US?
noah-benefits: Yes — COBRA packet includes elect/waive instructions and payment options. For international payments we recommend selecting credit-card autopay; otherwise coordinate with benefits@redwood.example for wire instructions.
lucas: Where do I upload docs and start the removal? Tried the portal but couldn't find the right event label.
peopleops-sarah: Steps: HR Portal > Benefits > Report a Life Event > Choose: "Remove dependent 9 qualifying life event (separation/divorce)" > Enter event date: 2026-03-10 > Attach documents > In notes: "Separation decree (Quebec) attached; certified translation pending". Or open a case and cc benefits@redwood.example.
lucas: Ok uploading now. Will attach decree + translation when ready. Thanks all.
payroll-bot: Case created: #BEN-90017. Expected benefits processing: 3-7 business days after complete documentation received.
